review: All 100 originals reviewed on ten existing numbered contact sheets in this pass; selected originals inspected at full size by the bike, rider and track agents.

mapping.limits: Authored bounded motion, not recovered human kinematics. Road heading/grade retained; wheelie pitch is not cancelled.
Stills establish postures, not timing curves; the smooth transition is an original animation choice.
Mechanical construction and dimensions are authored; contact positions preserve the existing rig.
Four fictional venues; no branded architecture or texture is extracted from the supplied imagery.
References inform compact training presentation. Timing feature, fixed spatial splits and thresholds are original game design.

contextOnly: The mixed pack also includes supermoto, dirt-bike, road-bike, menus, people and duplicated trailer viewpoints. These remain context, not proof that a MotoGP-specific change applies to every image.
